newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek parliament OKs re-appointment of bourse head.
newsitem.headline: Greek parliament OKs re-appointment of bourse head.

text.p: The Greek parliament approved the re-appointment of Athens bourse president Manolis Xanthakis to a fresh three-year term late on Wednesday, parliament officials told Reuters.
National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou appointed Xanthakis, an economics professor, to a fresh three-year term late in December.
The parliamentary committee approving the appointment has no power to overturn a minister's decision but could have chosen to embarrass the government by voting against it.

All ruling socialist party deputies on the committee voted in favour of Xanthakis, deputies from all opposition parties voted against, except for the small left coalition party, which abstained, the officials said.
An informal Reuters poll among brokers and analysts in early January showed widespread discontent with Papandoniou's decision to re-appoint Xanthakis. -- Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
